# Privacy Policy

Your privacy is our top priority. Aura is designed with HIPAA compliance in mind.

## Data Security
- All data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
- We do not sell your data to third parties.
- Clinical data is used solely for the purpose of providing AI-assisted insights.

## HIPAA Compliance
- Our HIPAA Disguise feature ensures that PII is masked before processing.
- We maintain strict access controls and audit logs.
